# When One Component's State Becomes Everyone's Problem

#### Course: Learn React Zustand: The Smarter Way to Handle Data

## When One Component's State Becomes Everyone's Problem

To share local state with other components, you pass it down as props.

Think of it like a manager who needs to pass a message to someone on their team. But instead of telling them directly, the message has to go through every single person in between.

![When One Component's State Becomes Everyone's Problem](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

The team lead passes it to the senior dev, the senior dev passes it to the mid dev, the mid dev finally passes it to the junior who actually needed it. Everyone else was just a middleman.

That is prop drilling. Data passing through components that do not need it, just to reach the one that does.
